summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off their 2026/27 campaign with an exciting new-look squad featuring fresh signings and a returning player to bolster their promotion push. The Ramblers showed competitive spirit in their recent friendly against St Helens, though they'll be looking to convert chances more ruthlessly as the season approaches. With three brand new kits and player details being released, there's plenty of positive momentum building ahead of the big kickoff!
